networkDiscovery.notes: chrome-devtools MCP opened https://www.rolex.com/en-hk/watches/find-rolex?group=0 and https://www.rolex.com/zh-hant-hk/watches/find-rolex?group=0 in real browser tabs; confirmed the page title read 'Rolex® (HK)' / '勞力士® (HK)' with no unwanted redirect to another market, and that document.documentElement.lang was 'zh-hant' on the zh-hant-hk page. The site's __INITIAL_STATE script tag was inspected to find the official locale-code mapping ({"cms":"zh-hant","country":"HK","ws":"zh-hant","www":"zh-hant-hk"}), which identified the catalog webservice language parameter (language=zh-hant). Network access to the structured catalog endpoint was then performed via evaluate_script running fetch() calls inside that same live browser tab context (same technique as the AT/DE/US/GB runs), which succeeded because it carried the real browser session/TLS fingerprint. This was the primary and only collection path used; no fallback tool was needed.

responseFields.dialAlt: alt (segment after '錶面 : ', before trailing ', Rolex')

primaryCollectionPath.pagination: A single request with firstResult=0 and numberOfResults=2000 (exceeding the market's true total) returned totalCount=1465 and results.length=1465 in one response, i.e. results.length === totalCount with no further page available. This was independently corroborated by (1) a second request with numberOfResults=500, which returned the same fixed totalCount=1465 with results.length=500 (showing totalCount does not vary with the requested page size), and (2) a third request with firstResult=1465 (starting past the reported end), which returned totalCount=1465 and results.length=0, confirming no further page exists beyond the first response.

renderedCrossCheck.view: All models view; group=0; no restrictive collection, size, material, gender, or new-model filters
renderedCrossCheck.buttonText: 顯示更多 / 查看更多 (rendered UI not click-walked; see notes)
renderedCrossCheck.renderedCountsAfterEachLoad: Not enumerated by click-through. The structured endpoint's terminal totalCount === results.length signal plus the empty-page-past-the-end probe (see primaryCollectionPath.pagination) were used as the primary stop condition, and 19 individual official product pages (17 collection representatives plus both members of 2 same-base-model configuration pairs) were independently fetched from the live browser session as raw rendered HTML and reconciled against the structured dataset (see independentSpotChecks in validation-summary.json). Every one of the 1,465 structured modelReference values was also independently reconciled against the pre-existing cross-market catalog (data/catelog/rolex-catalog.json), which was already built and cross-checked from JP/TW/DE/US/AT/GB collection runs.

catalogReconciliation.notes: Every HK modelReference already existed in the catalog from prior JP/TW/DE/US/AT/GB collection runs (0 in HK only, 0 in catalog only) -- an exact 1,465-to-1,465 set match. The catalog's watches array, watchCount, and collectedAt are byte-for-byte unchanged; only sourceMarketCodes gained 'HK'. Every HK familyCode also matched the existing catalog collectionId for the same modelReference with 0 mismatches.
